designDirection.goal: Remove template recognisability while keeping the dark, single-page, section-based layout Gene likes; layer an Apple-style liquid-glass material on surfaces.

whatToChange.palette: Replace the four Chiang tokens. Direction: near-black with a cool tint for ground, layered glass surfaces instead of flat #112240 cards, one accent that is not mint-green.
whatToChange.opener: Drop 'Hi, my name is'. Lead with the name or with the one-line positioning statement.
whatToChange.sectionHeadings: Drop '01.' numbering + trailing rule. Use small uppercase eyebrow label + large heading, or heading only.
whatToChange.socialStrip: Remove the bottom-left horizontal-line social strip. Put socials in header right or footer.
whatToChange.keep: Space Mono as the mono accent is fine but pair with a distinctive display face; dark mode; section order; globe.

proposedTokens.note: Starting point, tune visually. Defined as CSS custom properties; MUI theme reads from them until MUI is dropped.

liquidGlassRecipe.surface: .glass { background: var(--glass-fill); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid var(--glass-stroke); border-radius: var(--radius-card); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12) inset, 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
liquidGlassRecipe.specularEdge: .glass::before { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:inherit; padding:1px; background: var(--glass-highlight); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events:none; }
liquidGlassRecipe.innerRefraction: .glass::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:-40%; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255,255,255,0.10), transparent 70%); transform: translate(var(--mx,0), var(--my,0)); pointer-events:none; transition: transform .6s ease; } /* set --mx/--my from pointer for a moving light */
liquidGlassRecipe.backgroundNeedsColor: Glass only reads as glass if there is something colourful/blurred behind it. Replace the flat navy with 2-3 large, slow-moving blurred colour blobs (radial-gradients on a fixed canvas or CSS @keyframes) in accent hues at low alpha. This also replaces the particle network.
liquidGlassRecipe.noise: Optional 2-3% opacity SVG feTurbulence noise overlay on the body to kill banding.
liquidGlassRecipe.restraint: Use glass for: header bar, cards, dialog, country card. Do NOT glass the whole section background. Max 2 glass layers stacked.
liquidGlassRecipe.reducedMotion: Freeze blob movement and light-follow under prefers-reduced-motion.

typography.display: One of: 'Instrument Serif' (editorial contrast, very un-template), 'Geist' (clean, Vercel-adjacent), 'Bricolage Grotesque' (character). Recommend Instrument Serif for headings + Geist for body: memorable pairing.
typography.mono: Keep Space Mono, or Geist Mono for consistency
typography.load: Self-host woff2 via @fontsource-variable, preload display + body, font-display: swap, remove Google Fonts link
